annotation.title_clean: Commission Recommendation (EU) 2024/915 of 19 March 2024 on measures to combat counterfeiting and enhance the enforcement of intellectual property rights
annotation.title_en: Commission Recommendation (EU) 2024/915 of 19 March 2024 on measures to combat counterfeiting and enhance the enforcement of intellectual property rights
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Recommendation encouraging Member States, rightsholders and intermediaries to combat counterfeiting and piracy and improve IP enforcement through voluntary cooperation, trusted flaggers, dynamic injunctions, criminal penalties, and technology use. A short chapter encourages AI for detection and an SME AI checklist; no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Encourages voluntary cooperation via MoUs and trusted flagger status under the Digital Services Act
Good practices for transport, payment, social media and domain name providers
Promotes dynamic injunctions, right of information, appropriate and punitive damages
Encourages stronger criminal penalties and specialised IP crime units
Encourages AI and blockchain tools against counterfeiting and an SME AI/IP checklist; review within three years
